contradicting_evidence: Final, parity-checked ETF totals for October 13 were positive: BTC +175.7 million USD and ETH +24.8 million USD. Older negative-flow context should not replace this newer session.
Stablecoin supply increased about 0.84% over 30 days and was slightly positive over one day, although deployment is unconfirmed.
The latest hourly rebound and fearful sentiment allow a larger relief rally; supplied funding readings alone do not establish extreme leverage stress.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Renewed weakness after intermittent rebounds is modestly favored over durable expansion. A BTC-led stabilization could occur without improving ETH/BTC or repairing altcoin participation. Sustained downside continuation is not yet confirmed, so the forecast remains vulnerable to improving spot demand and follow-through in flows.
falsification_conditions: BTC and ETH sustain recovery across subsequent sessions while ETH/BTC improves and observed beta participation broadens.
Later settled ETF sessions sustain positive demand and coincide with price resilience rather than remaining an isolated flow improvement.
Spot-led buying persists without corresponding renewed breadth deterioration or dependence on leverage expansion.
missing_evidence: A multi-session price and breadth sequence establishing persistence beyond the supplied selloff.
ETF settlements after October 13 and evidence that positive flows are sustained.
Repeated ETH/BTC observations and confirmation that stablecoin supply is being deployed.
supporting_evidence: Observed beta participation was exceptionally weak: approximately 5.9% of large-alt proxies, 0% of mid-alt proxies and 4.8% of small-alt proxies advanced over 24h.
Only about 13%–19% of constituents in those buckets outperformed BTC. This supports relative BTC resilience, not transmission into altcoins.
ETH/BTC was flat during the latest rebound hour, providing no immediate evidence of improving ETH leadership.
Stablecoin supply fell about 0.52% over seven days, and deployment confirmation is absent; available liquidity cannot be equated with active demand.
